legend: Retropharyngeal lymphadenopathy and Waldeyer ring fullness in a patient with ataxia–telangiectasia.
Strong CD20 expression in a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the neck in a patient with ataxia–telangiectasia.

diagnosis: Somatic ATM mutation in squamous cell carcinoma
legend: Somatic mutations in ATM have been reported with increasing frequency in a variety of tumour types, including squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck. In this example, next-generation sequencing detected several somatic gene variants involving ATM, including this ATM p.Q1416* nonsense variant, in a lymph node metastasis from a patient with a history of facial squamous cell carcinomas.
